answers.text: Have it return the same three-line shape every time — date, item/quantity, then change. The date line is just the date, the item line is item plus quantity, the third is the change or 'no change'.
Get it to list every claim on its own line with date, amount, category and submitter, then a total. The total should be all the listed amounts added together for the week.

Something in the dates here doesn't add up. The email says the 19th is three days from today, but the call it references was the 14th, five days off. So either the 19th or the 'three days' is wrong — one of those has to be off.
62 up from 54 does come close to 15%, that checks out. 3 late out of 62 is nearer 95% on-time, not 97%.
I'd sign off Output 2 — it shows its working.

I'd send Reply 2 — it's got the order number and credit reference in it. Reply 1 just says 'entirely our error' without saying how anyone knows that. It's not that Reply 1 is wrong, I'd just want it backed up before it goes.
